lean/docs/091.md:9: The logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski conjecture asserts that logarithmic interpolation of origin-symmetric convex bodies preserves the geometric-mean lower bound for volume. The formalized result proves, for every dimension $n\ge1$, such bodies $K,L\subset\mathbb R^n$, and $0\le t\le1$, that their logarithmic Wulff combination has volume at least $|K|^{1-t}|L|^t$. It assumes neither boundary smoothness nor coordinatewise unconditionality.
